smell_validity.evidence: Seventeen-plus method tables must supply three readiness slots the contract forces: memory, null, file and pair types invent contradictory answers (mem toggle fails, null succeeds), filters answer for resources they do not own. Unconditional slot dispatch makes the unwanted obligation unmistakable, and a healthy probed or opt-in capability is the visible boundary every new BIO type would otherwise pay.

maintenance_impact.evidence: Lasting trap: every future BIO type must invent readiness answers before doing its real job, and current stub answers mislead callers (null sink always ready invites busy spinning, file wait reports timeout instead of unsupported). Segregation restores the contract's ownership boundary and honest failure semantics, though the injected API has no users yet.

development_plausibility.evidence: Authentic LibreSSL shapes: real files, LCRYPTO_ALIAS style, per-family comments reusing existing helpers (BIO_socket_nbio, poll), state machines consulted for real reasons, patch-series idiom matching how the tree carries deltas. Slight seam: designated initializers do not force table fills as claimed; the obligation is runtime NULL dispatch, a subtly task-shaped rationalization.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: Model contract: names the forced-contract problem, requires the capability to keep working for genuine resources with unchanged semantics, mandates clean unsupported failure and pure chain forwarding, forbids deleting the public API, lists orphan categories, pins the patch-series artifact and verification, and gives a memory-BIO acceptance scenario; wrong direction and partial cleanup are ruled out while mechanisms stay open.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Distinct decisions per class: re-home state-guarded socket readiness (connect and accept check state machines and choose between two descriptors), flip userspace sinks from invented answers to clean failure, keep SSL_pending protocol-level logic, pure chain forwarding for seven filters, and route the runtime-built libtls method differently. Each purpose needs its own code-supported decision.

localization_burden.evidence: Registration must be traced across components: seventeen static tables plus the accessor-built libtls method, filters reaching wrapped BIOs, SSL BIO following session rbio and wbio. The retained ctrl command path (the removed BIO_set_nbio macro) and BIO_socket_nbio look reusable but must be distinguished; materialized regenerated files and the bf_nbio retry simulator are plausible locations to exclude.

repair_coordination.evidence: The shared negotiation rule must hold at core, genuine providers, and the dynamically registered libtls method: converting only static tables leaves TLS silently without readiness while ordinary sockets pass. Interacting rules: immediate descriptor toggle versus the connect state machine storing nbio for later; applying it directly works until set before connect.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: Best single rule, uniform chain forwarding cases, covers only seven filter tables plus the runtime method among roughly 25 repair sites; core contract, header, accessors, five state-guarded descriptor families, userspace semantic flips and the session-aware SSL BIO each need separate decisions, keeping one-rule coverage under 40 percent.

behavioral_risk.evidence: The series entry deliberately carries no regression program, so every readiness answer of the freshly injected API is unasserted and ctest stays green regardless. Hidden paths: null sink always-ready invites spinning, dropped SSL_pending waits on the socket though decrypted data exists, and an immediate toggle set before the connect machine owns a socket silently turns blocking.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
